detailed_descriptions.en: " Long before our realm came to be, stories were told of the Guivre, a majestic jewelled serpentine beast, sporting wings so vast and talons so sharp that it could swipe sheep right under the nose of unwary shepherds! Nowadays, whether out of awe or fear, villagers build these outstanding landmarks to honour the mighty serpent. " The Guivre Garden pays homage to the Guivre, a mythical beast from Medieval France. This special building contains 18 parts , with a main statue and 3 secondary statues.
